discussion: A cybersecurity strategy articulates an organisation’s vision, guiding principles, objectives and priorities for cybersecurity, typically over a five-year period. In addition, a cybersecurity strategy may also cover an organisation’s threat environment, cybersecurity initiatives or investments the organisation plans to make as part of its cybersecurity program. Without a cybersecurity strategy, an organisation risks failing to adequately plan for and manage security and business risks within their organisation.
section_path: Development and maintenance of cybersecurity documentation
title: A cybersecurity strategy is developed, implemented and maintained.
